ops.title: P3 red set: test-suite reconstruction lane inputs
ops.body:
# P3 red set: what the reconstruction lane inherits

After the object-model inversion (worktree p3-inversion, golden c74c237c, views
21c7cda5, switch 82e3fe47, facades 366075ab, runtime fixes 1e0dc21f-or-HEAD), the
full pytest run is 2342 tests: 1593 passed, 749 failed, 5 modules error at
collection. Every red entry is reconstruction-category — zero known true
regressions remain. The two true regressions found were fixed in-lane:
render.py event_dict used dataclasses.asdict (now a __match_args__-driven
projector), and three gen_*_golden.py scripts + test_filter_parity unpacked
recv()'s old (path, mtime, events) tuple (now Transcript.events; all four
suites green over views).

Categories:

**A. Hand-built dataclass constructions** — `TypeError: cannot create '…'
instances` (views have no Python constructors by design except
Question/Hunk/EditSpan/QuestionAnnotation; the plan's fix is JSONL fixtures via
a new tests/testkit.py snippet-parser). Modules: test_filterspec (48),
test_query (38), test_facts (12), test_context (10), test_evidence (9),
test_sentiment (8), test_sampling (8), test_cost (6), test_tools (6),
test_extract (6), test_scorespec (3), test_mining_spec (2), and five modules
failing at COLLECTION because tests/support.py helpers (meta/user/assistant,
~L30-105) build events at import: test_activity, test_filters, test_models,
test_notifications, test_render. Reworking support.py's three helpers to
synthesize a JSONL line and parse it un-reds most of category A in one move.

**B. Dead Python-reference legs** — parity suites whose Python side drives the
parser.py decoder tree or watch.py's Python tail, both P6 deletion targets; the
Rust legs of the same suites pass. Modules: test_context_parity (185),
test_cost_parity (121), test_mining_parity (75), test_parser (56),
test_buckets_parity (32), test_notifications_parity (23), test_render_parity
(7), test_watch (10; the Python tick yields [] because decode_line cannot
materialize), test_watch_parity (3). Per suite: keep the Rust-vs-golden leg,
delete the Python-reference leg (P6 deletes those bodies anyway).

**C. Obsolete dict-projection harness** — test_toolcall_parity (81): compares
parse_tool_call views against call_to_dict/result_to_dict dicts. Superseded by
tests/test_views_parity.py (views_golden.json pins all 15 call + 11 result
classes, raises and digests included). Delete or re-shape over the golden.

Equipment: tests/viewgolden.py (compare() replays golden nodes against live
views), tests/testdata/views_edge/*.jsonl (committed fixtures covering every
event/block/detail/call/result class), tests/test_views_match.py (the
fleet-shaped keyword-match suite). scripts/gen_views_golden.py can only run
against an eager path, which no longer exists — views_golden.json is frozen.
ops.when: starting the P3 test-suite reconstruction lane in the p3-inversion worktree, or triaging a pytest failure that constructs cc-transcript model objects by hand
